name.en-US: The Spiritual Espousals (Adornment of the Spiritual Marriage)

description.dum: Ruusbroecs hoofdwerk in drie boeken: het werkende leven, het innige leven en het godschouwende leven, naar Mt 25,6 'Ecce sponsus venit'. Middelnederlandse tekst van J. B. David (1868), met handschriftvarianten en Surius' Latijn in voetnoten.
description.en-US: Ruusbroec's masterpiece in three books on the active, the interior and the contemplative life, a commentary on 'Behold the Bridegroom comes' (Mt 25:6). The Middle Dutch text of J. B. David (1868), with manuscript variants and Surius' Latin readings in footnotes.
description.pt-BR: A obra-prima de Ruusbroec em três livros sobre a vida ativa, a vida interior e a vida contemplativa, comentário de 'Eis o Esposo que vem' (Mt 25,6). Texto em neerlandês médio de J. B. David (1868), com variantes de manuscritos em notas.

sources.edition: Jan van Ruusbroec, Werken, ed. J. B. David, deel 6: Hier beghint die chierheit der gheesteleker brulocht. Dat ierste boec. (Gent: Maetschappy der Vlaemsche Bibliophilen, 1868).
sources.description: Keyed text from DBNL (TEI XML, 'auteursrechtvrij'), converted by research/sourcing/_scripts/rhineland/ruus_build.py. Line-end hyphens joined; page and line breaks dropped. David's apparatus is kept as footnotes (manuscript variants F, G, I, L, M, D, Surius' Latin readings 'Sur.'). David's Dutch preface, manuscript list, misprint list and glossary are not included.
sources.tierEvidence: Nineteenth-century critical edition, marked 'Auteursrechtvrij' on DBNL.
